prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon preparation with carbohydrate loading and high calorie intake for endurance training

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains 4-5 meals/snacks totaling 3000+ calories appropriate for marathon training
Includes high carbohydrate content (55-65% of total calories) for energy and glycogen loading
All meals are vegetarian and nut-free
Plan is presented in compact, single-day format with clear timing
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high calorie intake and carbohydrate loading, emphasizing energy density and recovery nutrition

prompt_inputs.goal: Muscle gain and strength improvement through weightlifting with emphasis on protein intake and recovery

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day with protein-rich options at each meal
Total daily protein intake meets or exceeds 1.6-2.2g per kg of body weight (136-187g minimum)
Meals are timed strategically around training with pre and post-workout nutrition included
Plan is compact and concise (single day format, easily readable)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-training athlete (weightlifter) with specific macronutrient ratios prioritizing protein intake and muscle recovery across meal timing

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain energy and performance for tournament play with quick recovery between matches
prompt_inputs.restrictions: Lactose intolerant, prefers no heavy meals 2 hours before competition

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 5-6 eating occasions (breakfast, snack, lunch, pre-match snack, dinner) with appropriate timing before/after competition
All meals are lactose-free and avoid heavy foods within 2 hours of match play
Includes hydration recommendations and quick-energy options suitable for between-set consumption
Provides balanced macronutrients (carbohydrates for energy, protein for recovery, healthy fats) appropriate for a 78kg athlete
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete (tennis player) needing balanced nutrition with hydration considerations, quick energy options, and meals that don't cause digestive discomfort during competition
